description: Model age-dependent penetrance of ATM genotypes against SEER incidence and test surveillance thresholds
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# SEER 22 female breast cancer age-specific incidence, cases per 100,000 per year
# (SEER*Explorer, invasive female breast cancer, all races, 2017-2021; values rounded)
ages  = np.array([20,25,30,35,40,45,50,55,60,65,70,75,80])
rates = np.array([1.4,8.1,24.6,54.0,109.1,174.0,221.6,265.5,345.0,428.0,463.0,447.0,413.0])/1e5

# Relative risks for germline ATM genotypes (female breast cancer)
# CARRIERS population-based case-control, ATM protein-truncating: OR 2.10 (95% CI 1.71-2.57)  PMID 33471974
# BRIDGES, ATM PTV: OR 2.10 (95% CI 1.71-2.59)                                                PMID 33471991-class estimate
# ATM c.7271T>G missense (dominant negative): RR ~ 4-6 in family-based series                 PMID 12195425 / 10814674
GENO = {"Non-carrier (SEER baseline)": (1.00, 1.00, 1.00),
        "ATM PTV carrier (OR 2.10)":   (2.10, 1.71, 2.57),
        "ATM c.7271T>G (RR 5.0)":      (5.00, 4.00, 6.00)}

def cum_risk(rr):
    # competing-risk-free cumulative incidence from age 20: 1 - exp(-integral of hazard)
    h = rates*rr
    cum = np.concatenate([[0], np.cumsum(h[:-1]*np.diff(ages))])
    return 1-np.exp(-cum)

curves={}
for k,(rr,lo,hi) in GENO.items():
    curves[k]=(cum_risk(rr), cum_risk(lo), cum_risk(hi))

tab=pd.DataFrame({k:np.round(100*v[0],1) for k,v in curves.items()}, index=ages)
tab.index.name="age"
print("=== Cumulative female breast cancer risk (%) by age and ATM genotype ===")
print(tab.to_string())
for k,(m,lo,hi) in curves.items():
    print(f"{k:32s} risk by 80: {100*m[-1]:.1f}% (95% CI {100*lo[-1]:.1f}-{100*hi[-1]:.1f})"
          f" | by 50: {100*m[list(ages).index(50)]:.1f}%")

# --- Surveillance threshold: at what age does an ATM PTV carrier reach the
#     cumulative risk a non-carrier only reaches at age 50 (the usual mammography start)?
base50 = curves["Non-carrier (SEER baseline)"][0][list(ages).index(50)]
for k in ["ATM PTV carrier (OR 2.10)","ATM c.7271T>G (RR 5.0)"]:
    m=curves[k][0]
    a=np.interp(base50, m, ages)
    print(f"{k:32s} reaches the age-50 population risk ({100*base50:.2f}%) at age {a:.1f}")

# --- NCCN uses a 20% lifetime threshold for annual breast MRI ---
for k,(m,lo,hi) in curves.items():
    if m[-1]>=0.20:
        print(f"{k}: crosses the 20% lifetime threshold for MRI surveillance "
              f"(risk by 80 = {100*m[-1]:.1f}%)")
    else:
        print(f"{k}: stays below the 20% lifetime MRI threshold ({100*m[-1]:.1f}%)")

# --- figure ---
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,5.5))
ax=axes[0]
cols={"Non-carrier (SEER baseline)":"#888888","ATM PTV carrier (OR 2.10)":"#4878a8","ATM c.7271T>G (RR 5.0)":"#c44e52"}
for k,(m,lo,hi) in curves.items():
    ax.plot(ages,100*m,lw=2.2,color=cols[k],label=k)
    ax.fill_between(ages,100*lo,100*hi,color=cols[k],alpha=0.15)
ax.axhline(20,ls="--",c="k",lw=1)
ax.text(21,21,"20% lifetime risk: NCCN threshold for annual breast MRI",fontsize=8)
ax.axvline(40,ls=":",c="k",lw=1); ax.text(40.5,2,"age 40",fontsize=8,rotation=90)
ax.set_xlabel("Age (years)"); ax.set_ylabel("Cumulative breast cancer risk (%)")
ax.set_title("Age-dependent penetrance of germline ATM genotypes\nSEER age-specific incidence scaled by genotype relative risk",fontsize=11)
ax.legend(fontsize=9,loc="upper left"); ax.grid(alpha=0.3)

ax2=axes[1]
# organ-specific relative risks from published case-control series
org=pd.DataFrame({
 "site":["Breast (female)","Pancreas","Prostate (aggressive)","Ovary","Colorectal","Gastric","Melanoma"],
 "or":[2.10,4.21,2.58,1.57,1.23,2.0,1.1],
 "lo":[1.71,3.24,1.78,1.21,0.9,1.1,0.7],
 "hi":[2.57,5.47,3.75,2.03,1.7,3.6,1.7]})
org=org.sort_values("or")
y=np.arange(len(org))
ax2.errorbar(org["or"],y,xerr=[org["or"]-org["lo"],org["hi"]-org["or"]],
             fmt="o",color="#4878a8",capsize=4,ms=7)
ax2.axvline(1,c="k",lw=1)
ax2.set_yticks(y); ax2.set_yticklabels(org["site"],fontsize=10)
ax2.set_xscale("log"); ax2.set_xticks([0.7,1,2,3,5]); ax2.set_xticklabels(["0.7","1","2","3","5"])
ax2.set_xlabel("Odds ratio / relative risk (log scale)")
ax2.set_title("Organ specificity of ATM heterozygote cancer risk\npoint estimate with 95% CI",fontsize=11)
ax2.grid(axis="x",alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
